description: Source code for user-related API endpoints in the focalboard server, including user retrieval, updating user configurations, and memberships.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API struct that contains methods for user-related endpoints and dependencies.

methods.name: registerUsersRoutes
methods.description: Registers user-related API routes to the provided mux router.

methods.name: handleGetUsersList
methods.description: Handles retrieving a list of users based on provided user IDs.

methods.name: handleGetMe
methods.description: Returns the currently logged-in user's information.

methods.name: handleGetMyMemberships
methods.description: Returns the board memberships of the current user.

methods.name: handleGetUser
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user's information by userID.

methods.name: handleUpdateUserConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration/preferences of a user, only if the user is updating their own.

methods.name: handleGetUserPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves preferences for the current user.
